messages.snippet: Please complete the attached registration packet, including immunization records and proof of address, and return it to the front office by {{date:2026-10-30|%B %-d, %Y}}.
messages.body:
Dear families,

Please complete the attached registration packet for the {{date:2027-09-01|%Y}} kindergarten intake. The packet needs the signed enrollment form, a copy of your child's immunization records, and proof of address (a utility bill or lease). Return it to the front office by {{date:2026-10-30|%B %-d, %Y}}.

Maplewood Elementary Registrar
